messages:
Lila (People Ops): heads up — Jordan Park submitted resignation, last day Friday 3/27. Need to confirm benefits end date, SSO deprovision window, and laptop return logistics. @Devon do you have a tentative knowledge-transfer plan?
Devon (Eng Manager): thanks Lila. I'll pair Jordan with Priya for docs + handoff. plan: runbook + 2-hour walkthrough Mon/Tue. will update the calendar invite.
Priya (IT): ok send me last day and preferred device return method. I'll create an IT ticket to revoke access on the last working hour.
Lila (People Ops): benefits: COBRA paperwork will be emailed on 3/28. coverage end = 3/31 (standard month-end). Jordan, confirm your personal email for the COBRA packet?
Jordan Park: thanks — use jordan.personal@gmail.com for COBRA + final W-2. also please confirm laptop return label.
Marisol (Payroll): final payout estimate posted: accrued PTO payout + prorated March salary. We'll process on next payroll (4/1). Jordan, expect a separate email with tax forms.
Priya (IT): created IT ticket #IT-8342 to handle SSO deprovision, G Suite transfer, and laptop label. On last day at 17:00 PT I'll run the deprovision checklist.
Oncall Bot: reminder queued: remove Jordan from PagerDuty and Slack group at 17:05 PT on 2026-03-27.
Alex (Security): quick security notes — please rotate any service account tokens Jordan had access to. If you need a hitlist, ping me and I'll export a list. Also we'll do a KMS key rotation for the project repo.
Devon (Eng Manager): I can export a list of repos and app access — will DM you, Alex. Jordan will hand over active PRs and add owners to the queue.
Priya (IT): laptop return options: 1) ship prepaid return label (we'll send via email) or 2) drop at SF office desk by EOD Fri. Jordan, which do you prefer?
Jordan Park: prepaid label please. happy to drop if needed but shipping is easier.
Lila (People Ops): noted. Jordan — HR exit interview link coming from People Ops. Optional but encouraged. Also reminder about NDAs and IP clause in the offer letter.
Marisol (Payroll): one more note — benefits coverage for dental/vision ends same day as medical (3/31). COBRA payment window 60 days after electing.
Alex (Security): action item list for security: revoke Okta SAML session, remove SSH keys from infra, rotate service tokens. Priya, can you run the following on the last day?
Priya (IT): yep — I'll run the commands and confirm in this thread.
Alex (Security): example revoke snippet (internal):
```
# revoke okta session
okta sessions revoke --user jordan.park@redwood.ai
# remove ssh keys
ssh-keygen -f /home/jordan/.ssh/authorized_keys -R jordan
```
Devon (Eng Manager): leaving a note for oncall — @team please reassign Jordan's oncall shifts. I'll add owners to the week-of schedule.
Lila (People Ops): thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the COBRA packet email and a checklist for last-day access revocations. :thumbsup:
Oncall Bot: IT-8342 updated: SSO deprovision scheduled 2026-03-27 17:00 PT.
Priya (IT): done — will post confirmation once completed on 3/27.
Marisol (Payroll): final confirmation sent to Jordan.personal@gmail.com.
Lila (People Ops): closing loop — everything assigned. please react with :white_check_mark: once your tasks are complete.
